jobs.occupation: Senior Mechanical & Piping Lead Project Engineer
jobs.description:
📋 Tasks and responsibilities

This position is a senior technical project engineering role rather than an administrative coordination or traditional project management function. You act as the technical lead within multidisciplinary CAPEX projects and help ensure that safe, feasible and maintainable solutions are delivered in a controlled project setting.

You work in an operational brownfield environment where safety, reliability, technical quality and minimal disruption to production are essential. The role combines deep Mechanical & Piping expertise with a broad multidisciplinary view across engineering, execution and handover.

Responsibilities

• Define and safeguard the technical basis, design philosophy, project scope and battery limits.
• Lead and integrate engineering activities across disciplines, with Mechanical & Piping as the core domain and close interaction with process, E&I, automation, civil, safety and infrastructure.
• Organise design reviews and evaluate solutions for safety, compliance, functionality, reliability, maintainability, constructability and lifecycle value.
• Translate process and project requirements into robust Mechanical & Piping concepts and oversee the quality of layouts, P&IDs, equipment specifications, piping classes, routing and isometrics.
• Assess technical options for feasibility, safety, reliability and cost-effectiveness.
• Provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, and challenge them on content, quality, planning and completeness of deliverables.
• Facilitate technical decision-making, document assumptions and deviations, and ensure traceable decisions and follow-up actions.
• Identify technical and project risks and evaluate the impact of changes on scope, schedule, cost, execution and business continuity.
• Support the preparation of technical specifications, tender packages, bid evaluations, supplier selection and contractual technical clarifications.
• Follow up Mechanical & Piping activities where relevant, including fabrication, inspections, FAT, delivery, installation, SAT and punch-list management through to mechanical completion.
• Provide engineering support during construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up and handover.
• Advise the Project Manager through clear technical recommendations and transparent reporting to stakeholders.
• Coach engineers and contribute to standards, methodologies, lessons learned and knowledge sharing within project engineering.
Location

Olen, with 100% onsite presence.

Selection procedure

The process consists of two interview rounds: a first interview via Teams, followed by an on-site interview including a business case.

• You hold a master's degree in a technical discipline, or you have built an equivalent level through relevant experience. A background in electromechanics or chemical technology is particularly relevant.
• You have extensive experience in technical design and engineering within an industrial or process environment.
• You bring demonstrable specialist knowledge of Mechanical & Piping engineering in the process industry or another heavy industrial setting.
• You have proven experience with multidisciplinary CAPEX projects from concept and basic engineering through execution and completion.
• You are able to provide technical direction to engineering partners, suppliers and contractors, and to assess their deliverables critically.
• You are familiar with applicable Mechanical & Piping standards and good engineering practices, such as PED, ATEX and EN 13480.
• You hold a VCA-VOL certificate or are willing to obtain it before the start.
• Knowledge of AutoCAD Plant 3D is an asset.
• You can work with project controls, including scope, schedule, costs, risks, changes and stakeholder management.
• You combine technical depth with a broad overview, decisiveness and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving.
• You explain complex technical topics clearly and communicate effectively with different stakeholders.
• You work in a structured, autonomous and results-oriented way, with a strong sense of ownership.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and professionally in English. Other languages are a plus.

Does this sound like you? Apply right away!

As a Recruitment Consultant, you'll be part of our Interim Management team, working at the intersection of people, business and opportunity.

You'll manage the recruitment process from start to finish, while building long-term relationships with organizations and professionals. No two days are the same: one moment you could develop a new business opportunity, the next you're speaking with an experienced professional about their next career move.

Above all, you're looking for more than just a job: you want to build a career where your ambition can grow with you.

Our client, a biotech company based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology enterprise bringing innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this initiative, the company makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are seeking motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.

What You’ll Do
	
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.	
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.	
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.	
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.	
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients.
Good to Know
You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends, but no night shifts. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
	
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.	
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.	
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 	
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.	
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

• Assemble AI-Blox devices under the supervision and guidance of the engineering team

• Comfortable working with tools, hardware components and production materials

• Proactive attitude and willingness to support different operational activities
• Experience in assembly, warehouse operations or production environments is a plus
• Basic understanding of electronics or electromechanical systems is an advantage

• Good communication skills in English

You make sure everything is stored properly, orders are ready on time, and the warehouse stays tidy.
Your day starts between 7 and 8 AM, depending on your training. You pick orders, load and unload trucks and containers, and handle the administrative tasks related to shipments. For this, you use a PC, printer, and ERP system. You carry out simple visual checks and make sure everything runs safely and according to company guidelines. You actively participate in the daily team meeting with your colleagues and support each other.
Ready to roll up your sleeves and feel at home in a warehouse? Apply quickly and make a difference in a growing company!

Conforma is a Contract Manufacturing Organisation (CMO) specialising in the manufacturing of non-sterile liquid and semi-solid pharmaceutical and medical device products, including solutions, syrups, gels and creams.
 

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities
 

· Identify and map potential customers across Europe and, subsequently, international markets
 

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential
 

· Identify relevant decision-makers and map professional contact details
 

· Use online research, professional networks, databases and direct telephone contact to obtain or verify information and establish the right point of contact
 

· Support targeted outbound campaigns and follow up qualified leads together with the Business Development team
 

· Support the organisation and commercial follow-up of relevant international trade fairs and industry events
 

· Help keep Conforma's LinkedIn company page professional, current and engaging by contributing to relevant posts and content

We are looking for someone who is curious, commercially minded, proactive and not afraid to pick up the phone. You enjoy investigating companies, finding information that is not immediately available and turning that information into actionable opportunities.
 

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken Dutch & English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. You will help build our international market map from the ground up: identifying potential customers, understanding their products and manufacturing footprint, discovering where outsourcing opportunities may exist and determining who we should speak to.
 

Your work will directly contribute to Conforma's international growth and give you the opportunity to build a broad network within the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.

• Assist in financial administration: this involves maintaining accurate document management of financial transactions, including invoices, receipts, and bank statements. The assistant may also be responsible for filing and organizing these records.

• Process invoices, reimbursements, and payments, including petty cash and bank card management. Ensure all the proofs of payment are compliant with internal rules.
